weaknesses.title: GREPALL multi-needle bag argument does not expand fields
weaknesses.detail: SYS GREPALL bag needles with needles='error\ndisk' yields LAST_N=0. Need separate string args GREPALL bag "error" "disk". Same silent-empty class as GREPANY bag needles — agents piping ENV/WORDS into one bag arg fail closed.
weaknesses.repro: GREPALL log needles_bag → 0; GREPALL log "error" "disk" → hits

weaknesses.title: GREPALL/GREPANY remain substring-unsafe
weaknesses.detail: Needle error matches host token error_soft. Multi-tag AND only partially mitigates (second needle may filter). No word-boundary / field-column GREP.

weaknesses.title: No in-field column update — SETMATCH needs full-row rebuild
weaknesses.detail: Status/sev ladder requires SPLIT + REPLACEALL template + SETMATCH whole row. No SETFIELD host status=review. Agents writing structured plates pay O(n) EACH + fragile rebuild.
weaknesses.repro: review/escalate actions: SPLIT old_entry; rebuild HOST:ST:SEV:TAG

weaknesses.title: REPLACEALL template tokens collide with data
weaknesses.detail: Rebuild uses REPLACEALL entry "SEV" sev etc. Host/tag containing SEV/HOST/ST/TAG substrings corrupt the template. No positional format/sprintf.
weaknesses.repro: host name containing SEV → garbled entry after REPLACEALL

weaknesses.title: Optional second ARG hard with DEFAULT/ENV defaults
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT A2=disk + ENV OR disk means filter cannot distinguish unset ARG2 from default. Single-needle GREPALL path only if A2 blank — agents always get 2-needle filter unless they blank env. No true optional CLI arity.
weaknesses.repro: filter ARG1 only still AND-matches default tag disk

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line evidence bags
weaknesses.detail: Filtered windows and full plates unparseable as one JSON string field.

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: cat -A last evidence line without $; intermediate lines have $.

weaknesses.title: Host identity is BEFORE first colon only
weaknesses.detail: Rows host:status:sev:tag break if host contains ':'. No multi-segment key extract helper for last field as host.
weaknesses.repro: host ipv6-like tokens cannot use colon plate format
